newsitem.title: DENMARK: Frankfurt, Paris lift Danish bond prices.
newsitem.headline: Frankfurt, Paris lift Danish bond prices.

text.p: Gains on other European markets gave Danish bond prices a slight lift on Monday, despite slack early trade and predictions of stagnation.
"The market is good, strong and positive, driven primarily by movements on the German and French markets," a dealer said.
The benchmark eight percent state bond due 2006 rose 0.10 point from Friday's close, to 108.30, in below-average turnover of 1.7 billion crowns.
Its December future rose 0.05 point to 108.11, with 113 contracts traded. The six percent mortgage bond due 2026 lost 0.30 point to 85.40.
